description: Module sets for tools.entrypoints.gc_baseline --load. Populations differ by an order of magnitude between profiles, so always name the profile when quoting a number.

bare.description: No preload; only interpreter startup objects (~10k). Compare runs on one host only.

core.description: Core application import chain only (~240k objects on Linux/3.12). Not the #2852 baseline population; use 'load-complete' for that.

load-complete.description: Closest approximation of the #2852 'complete load' condition (~730k objects here vs the issue's ~1.04M): Core, the LLM client stack and the heavy platform SDKs. Still short of the issue, which also had the plugin runtime and every adapter loaded.

http-adapters.description: Core plus the inbound HTTP controller stack, for comparing adapter-disabled runs against the loaded set.
